./internal/agent.note: PARTIAL: only the ten files steps#137 added were swept (ere, tree, treecontainer, treehost, treepath, treesearch, treesetup, probe, fatal, runnerfactory). The other 41 files in the package are unmeasured, so this row is not a statement about internal/agent as a whole. An unscoped first attempt reached editfile.go and conversation.go before it was stopped and showed ~35 survivors in editfile.go's edit-matching heuristics alone - unrelated to this change, and the obvious next group to sweep. Was 73.12 with 50 survivors. Four were real gaps and are now tested: the lexical half of the container path confinement (every case in the confinement test resolved to a real path, so rejectLinkEscape answered them all and inverting the string check left the test green - a path that escapes lexically with a nonexistent target was the missing case, and it is the security-relevant one); caseFolds indexing out[1] on a one-rune fold set, which only happens for a case-insensitive pattern holding a caseless character like (?i)v2; a NUL at position 0 slipping the container write guard; and a blind spot in the Go-based differential itself, which claimed ERE was a subset of RE2 - it is not, because RE2 reads a backslash inside a bracket as an escape where POSIX reads it as a literal, so the correct rendering of [a\\b] is [a-b\] which both real greps accept and Go rejects. That case moved to the docker parity test. WORKERS=1 throughout: this package now spawns containers in its own tests.
